title: Dubai Couple Escape
headline: A skyline stay, desert evening and the Gulf at your own pace.
description: Five nights in Dubai for two: one hotel, a desert evening and time for the fountain, souk or a marina walk.
price_label: Quoted for your hotel and dates
price_guidance: Dubai pricing depends on hotel category, desert-safari type and whether you add Abu Dhabi or a Burj Khalifa ticket. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A couple’s city break with one stay so you are not changing hotels. Mornings can be empty; evenings take the fountain, a dhow or the desert. Built around how you like a city — not a coach circuit.
highlights: Five nights in one Dubai hotel, area chosen with you.
A desert evening — shared or private — as quoted.
Time for Downtown, the souks or a marina walk.
Optional Burj Khalifa or Abu Dhabi day if you add it.
why: One hotel, five nights — city and desert without a packed coach list.
Dining can be planned around vegetarian preferences.
UAE visa guidance for Indian passports, timed to your tickets.
inclusions: Airport transfers in a private vehicle
One desert evening as specified in your quote
exclusions: Theme-park, Burj Khalifa and paid attraction tickets unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees
